import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    lt = np.log(t); lP = np.log(P)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*lt + p[2]*t + p[3]*P + p[4]*P**2
            + p[5]*P*t/(p[6]+t) + p[7]*lP/(1+t) + p[8]*lP*lt + p[9]*P**2*t)
